projects.name: Resume assistant
projects.text: Built a public resume application with a master-resume view and interfaces for retrieval-based Q&A, tailoring, interview preparation, and graph exploration.

projects.name: Code Turtle Engine
projects.text: Built a C#/.NET AI review tool using Roslyn-derived facts and parallel model reviewers, with citation checks against resolved symbols.

projects.name: Operon Job Hunter
projects.text: Built a multi-stage job-search and resume-tailoring workflow with graph-based retrieval, checkpointing, and a human approval boundary for submission.
